verdict.rationale: Neon's Management API has a public OpenAPI spec (probed live) and an LLM-addressed index grouping every endpoint by resource, including API key creation and branch AI Gateway endpoints. Neon documents fully automated project creation, configuration, and cleanup at scale through the API. A 113-tool MCP server and the CLI cover the same platform surface: projects, branches, snapshots, compute, Auth, Data API, Functions, Storage, and credentials. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that the API matches everything in the console, an accounting of any console-only features such as the SQL Editor's AI assistance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of that parity.
